Question ID: ENV_U06_L06_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ENV.SUS.03

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Policy Tradeoffs and Environmental Justice
Stimulus: Policy tradeoff scenario

A student reviews the required environmental evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Identify the policy, solution, or lifestyle choice. Then use the required stimulus (Policy tradeoff scenario) to connect the visible evidence to sustainability, conservation, policy, environmental justice, and future systems decisions. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ENV.SUS.03 and avoids the common mistake: assuming one stakeholder benefit means the policy is automatically the best environmental decision.
